subject: [AMBER] Register Now! Amber Free Energy Workshop 2024 at SDSC/UCSD, Aug. 12-16

messages.author: Darrin York
messages.body:
Dear All,
We are pleased to announce the Amber Free Energy Workshop 2024 that will
be held at SDSC (San Diego Supercomputing Center), which is located on
the UCSD campus.  Applications are open now through June 7, 2024.
Details on the workshop and application link can be found on the Amber
website:
https://ambermd.org/workshops/index.php
<
https://ambermd.org/workshops/index.php
>
*DATES:*
Monday August 12 to Friday August 16, 2024
*LOCATION:*
San Diego, CA, USA
*HOST:*
Dr. Andreas Goetz (SDSC)
*ORGANIZERS:*
Dr. Metin Aktulga (MSU), Dr. Andreas Goetz (SDSC), Dr. Kenneth Merz
(CCF), Dr. Darrin York (Rutgers)
*SCOPE:*
Workshop will consist of a series of lectures and hands-on exercises
designed to teach computational scientists best practices in carrying
out accurate, efficient and reliable free energy studies using Amber.
*
*
*TARGET AUDIENCE:*
Graduate students, postdocs and young faculty who have limited
experience in free energy methods and/or their use in the Amber software
and would benefit from an introductory workshop that also covers
advanced topics and the latest features in the Amber software, including
GPU acceleration.
*AVAILABLE SPACES:*
40
*REGISTRATION COSTS:*
Academic, Student, Government and Non-Profit Organizations: $350
Industry: $600
Registration fees are due only after an application is accepted.
Registration includes a reception, conference dinner, as well as coffee,
snacks and light refreshments during breaks.
*TRAVEL and ACCOMMODATION:*
Participants are expected to pay for their own travel and accommodation.
On-campus housing is being arranged to keep participation costs as low
as possible. Limited support for on-campus housing and/or domestic
flights may be provided depending on the availability of funds. See
website for more information.
Please forward this announcement to anybody you think may be interested
in this workshop.
Looking forward to seeing you in San Diego in August!
Metin, Andreas, Kennie & Darrin
--
